Central Region

Central

A trip here can move from forest canopy to fishing towns and the forts that hold some of Ghana’s most important history.

Cape Coast Castle · Photo: Jasmine Sackey-Addo

Capital

Cape Coast

Go for

Coast, castles and rainforest canopy

Good to know

Home to Kakum National Park and a coastline layered with difficult history.

Worth the trip.

Places in this region people keep coming back to. Not a ranking — a starting point.

  • Cape Coast Castle

    A UNESCO World Heritage site, and a place of difficult, necessary history.

    Visit Ghana guide ↗Wikipedia ↗

  • Kakum National Park

    Rainforest, and a canopy walkway strung between the trees.

    Visit Ghana guide ↗Wikipedia ↗

  • Elmina Castle

    Begun in 1482, the oldest European-built structure in sub-Saharan Africa.

    Visit Ghana guide ↗Wikipedia ↗

  • Assin Manso Ancestral Slave River

    The last bathing place before the coast, now a site of return.

    Visit Ghana guide ↗Wikipedia ↗

  • Hans Cottage Botel

    Crocodiles and birdlife a short drive from Cape Coast.
